experiments.experiment_label: mRNA-LNP hepatotropism confirmation via luciferase expression
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: We confirm specific hepatotropism of mRNA-LNP via intravenous injection of firefly luciferase encoding mRNA-LNP, with protein expression lasting about 3 days.
experiments.distinctness_reason: Distinct payload (luciferase reporter) and purpose (biodistribution/tropism confirmation) versus therapeutic experiments.

experiments.experiment_label: HGF mRNA-LNP in homeostatic liver to induce hepatocyte proliferation
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: In homeostasis, HGF mRNA-LNP efficiently induce hepatocyte proliferation.
experiments.distinctness_reason: Distinct disease context (homeostasis/no injury) and single payload (HGF only) versus injury models.

experiments.experiment_label: HGF and EGF mRNA-LNP in chronic liver injury (NAFLD) model
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: In a chronic liver injury mouse model recapitulating non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, injections of both HGF and EGF mRNA-LNP sharply reverse steatosis and accelerate restoration of liver function.
experiments.biological_model_mention: chronic liver injury mouse model recapitulating non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
experiments.distinctness_reason: Distinct disease context (chronic NAFLD model) and combination payload (HGF+EGF) versus homeostatic or acute injury experiments.

experiments.experiment_label: HGF and EGF mRNA-LNP in acetaminophen-induced acute liver injury
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: Likewise, HGF and EGF mRNA-LNP accelerate liver regeneration after acetaminophen-induced acute liver injury with rapid return to baseline ALT levels.
experiments.biological_model_mention: acetaminophen-induced acute liver injury mouse model
experiments.distinctness_reason: Distinct disease context (acute acetaminophen injury) and timepoint/outcome (rapid ALT return) versus chronic NAFLD or homeostatic experiments.
